notes.title: 🔥 Candy House Survival Camp – Limited-Time Recruitment on 4/1! 🔥
notes.content:
[h1]🔥 Candy House Survival Camp – Now Open for Recruitment! 🔥[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44861208/b528744c8fb924a9e96c5be792029e1b71bf1be3.jpg[/img]

[h3]🤔 Worried that your child isn’t independent enough?
😇 Think they’re too comfortable at home and don’t appreciate what they have?[/h3]

Here, we offer:

[h3]🍭 Candy Tent-Building Class:[/h3]
Let your child’s creativity shine! Using cookies as bricks and cream as paint, they’ll build their very own shelter!

[h3]🧙‍♀️ Witch’s Baking Workshop:[/h3]
Gather ingredients, experiment with recipes, and create delicious treats together!

[h3]🧸 Gingerbread Brothers Playtime:[/h3]
Two friendly gingerbread brothers will accompany them throughout the camp, along with adorable dolls and teddy bears—no chance of boredom!

✨ This is a fun-filled experience, and astonishingly, our campers have achieved an 8.7% survival rate within 72 hours! ✨

[h3]See what other parents have to say:[/h3]
💬 “This event is amazing! Finally, I can enjoy some quality time with my husband!”
💬 “Best camp ever! Peace and quiet at last, and no more complaints from the neighbors—best decision of my life!”
💬 “The activities are so engaging that my kid is having a blast. It’s been three months, and they still don’t want to come home!”

With our motto, "Happy kids, worry-free parents 🤍", we dedicate ourselves to creating the best camp experience!
Sign up now before it’s too late! 🏃‍♂️💨
